# Crack The Campus
> Placement preparation platform for engineering students in India: company-wise aptitude and coding practice, proctored mock tests in a desktop app, and the CTC Score (a 0–10 placement readiness score). Colleges get an admin suite for proctored internal exams and readiness analytics.

- [Home](https://crackthecampus.com/)
- [Infosys placement preparation](https://crackthecampus.com/prep/infosys/)
- [For colleges](https://crackthecampus.com/colleges/)
- [Pricing](https://crackthecampus.com/pricing/): Free ₹0 forever; Pro from ₹3,499 for 6 months; Pro + Placement from ₹7,499 for 6 months
- [Python for placements course](https://crackthecampus.com/courses/python/)
- [Code Nova 3 contest](https://crackthecampus.com/contests/code-nova-3/)
- [Placement guides](https://crackthecampus.com/guides/)
- [About](https://crackthecampus.com/about/)
- [Contact](https://crackthecampus.com/contact/)
